hook.name: PoolStartegyHooks
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that gates pool initialization and liquidity addition to calls from a PoolStrategyFactory. On each swap, applies a time-decaying buy fee (starting at 95%, declining to 10% over time) and distributes collected fees — optionally converting them to ETH via a nested swap — to a strategy vault, collection owner, and protocol fee address.
